newsitem.title: INDIA: India United Phos down 9.8 pct on result.
newsitem.headline: India United Phos down 9.8 pct on result.

text.p: Shares of chemicals firm United Phosphorus were trading 18.50 rupees or 9.8 percent lower at 169.50 rupees at noon on Monday after disappointing first half results announced last week, traders said.
The firm said on Thursday its net profit fell to 185.3 million rupees in the six months to September 30, 1996 from 260.8 million a year ago.
United Phosphorus shares were pounded 4.6 percent lower on Friday, traders said.
First half net profit was hit by sharply higher interest costs which were at 221.8 million rupees against 42.1 million a year ago.
